validation.PACK_ZIP_INVALID: The file isn't a valid zip archive.
validation.PACK_TOO_LARGE: The pack is larger than {limit} (after unzipping, or as a zip file).
validation.PACK_TOO_MANY_FILES: The pack has more than {limit} files.
validation.PACK_PATH_UNSAFE: {path}: path must be a plain relative path inside the pack.
validation.PACK_PATH_DUPLICATE: {path}: another file has the same path (ignoring letter case).
validation.PACK_LINK_NOT_ALLOWED: {path}: links and special files aren't allowed; only regular files.
validation.PACK_FILE_TYPE: {path}: this file type isn't allowed in a pack.
validation.PACK_MANIFEST_MISSING: pack.json is missing from the root of the pack.
validation.PACK_LICENSE: pack.json: license must be AGPL-3.0-only, AGPL-3.0-or-later or AGPL-3.0, not "{license}".
validation.PACK_LICENSE_FILE: The pack needs a LICENSE file with the GNU Affero General Public License text.
validation.PACK_API_VERSION: pack.json: apiVersion {apiVersion} isn't supported by this version of eyeread.in (supported: {supported}).
validation.PACK_APP_VERSION: This pack needs eyeread.in {minAppVersion} or later.
validation.PACK_MAIN_MISSING: {path}: the main file named in pack.json doesn't exist.
validation.PACK_MINIFIED: {path}: code looks minified or obfuscated; packs must include readable source.
validation.PACK_NETWORK_SITE: pack.json: "{site}" under {permission} must be an exact https:// site, like https://api.example.com (no wildcards, paths, IP addresses or localhost).
validation.PACK_INCLUDE_MISSING: pack.json: included pack {id}@{version} isn't in packs/{id}/.
validation.PACK_INCLUDE_DUPLICATE: pack.json: {id} is included more than once.
validation.PACK_INCLUDE_LIMIT: The bundle includes more than {limit} packs or nests deeper than {depth} levels.
validation.PACK_INCLUDE_UNUSED: packs/{id}/ isn't included by any pack in this bundle.
validation.PACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The signature doesn't match this pack. It may have been modified.

runtime.E_PERMISSION: This pack doesn't have the {permission} permission, or the user switched it off.
runtime.E_NETWORK_DENIED: {host} isn't an allowed site for {permission}, or internet access is off.
runtime.E_TOO_LARGE: The request or response is larger than {limit}.
runtime.E_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; try again shortly.
runtime.E_BUSY: Another request of this kind is already waiting for the user.
runtime.E_UNSUPPORTED: {method} isn't available in this version of eyeread.in.
